aggregate_brief: Today's standouts: GB Power — 97th-percentile of 5-yr range — historically high; Coal — 7th-percentile of 5-yr range — historically low; EU Storage — 16.8 pp below the 5-yr seasonal average.

news.geopolitics_summary: US-Iran escalation and Hormuz tensions threaten crude/LNG supply routes; EU diplomacy stalled. Libya ramping production to fill void.

themes.headline: US-Iran military strikes escalate; Hormuz shipping corridor threatened
themes.why_it_matters: Strait of Hormuz disruption risk raises crude prices, pressuring EU power fuel-switch economics and heating cost pass-through into 2026-27 power forwards.

themes.headline: Libya targets European energy void from Hormuz geopolitical premium
themes.why_it_matters: Increased Libyan crude flows to EU displace priced-in risk premium, lowering marginal fuel cost for EU power generation; offsets some Hormuz upside risk.

themes.headline: Norway pushes EU for Arctic oil/gas drilling amid declining output
themes.why_it_matters: Norwegian gas supply critical for winter 2026-27 EU baseload. Arctic expansion signals intent to maintain export volumes; reduces LNG import dependency and TTF price risk.

themes.headline: Data center demand expansion in EU drives incremental power load debate
themes.why_it_matters: Growing data-center load (Google Austria case) structurally raises EU peak demand; supports forward curve and reduces need for demand destruction via high prices.

themes.headline: France-Germany Industrial Accelerator Act dispute over carbon rules
themes.why_it_matters: Regulatory clarity on ETS/carbon cost allocation to heavy industry affects EU ETS forward pricing and power-to-hydrogen arbitrage incentives; policy outcome TBD.

watchlist: Hormuz shipping incident or Strait closure; immediate crude/power spike risk.
EU Commission von der Leyen State of Union speech (climate/energy priorities); policy signalling on ETS, decarbonization pace.
Libya crude export ramping timeline and EU import share data.
Norway Arctic drilling permit decision and first-gas timelines.
